_schema: v1. bullets[]: id, name, type, damage, rarity, effect, notes, in_game (bool, true = 已入库), created_at, updated_at (ISO, +08:00). New rows arrive via inbox/*.json and are merged by .github/workflows/bullet-editor-ingest.yml.

bullets.name: 起势弹
bullets.effect: 射击后，当前弹夹内后续子弹伤害+10％，多个本子弹效果可以叠加

bullets.name: 蓄力弹
bullets.effect: 发射后，下一颗子弹伤害×1.5。多个本子弹效果可以叠加，例如两颗本子弹连在一起，效果为下一颗子弹伤害×2.25
